AI trader pick withheld: AI_TRADER_ENABLED=False (CEO 2026-10-19); stale ZEN pick from 12:50 should be cleared before any re-enable.

3. Skip BLUR/BABY/ALT pending picks this cycle; COMP LONG (RSI 54.8) is the only in-band candidate.
4. Prefer continuum-trend/trail-confirmed entries over pump-chain+/r2v2-long3 until volume_regime expands.

regime_context:
Regime: LONG, drifting. BTC 15m LONG_BIAS, 4h LONG_BIAS, continuum ABOVE EMA300 for 1049 minutes (price 84572 vs 84029), trend_quality STRONG_UP, linreg LEAN_BULL — but volume_regime LOW, velocity SLOW, acceleration NEGATIVE, market_phase DECLINING, volatility LOW. Aggregate 15m: 91 long-bias / 6 short-bias / 32 neutral across 129 tokens.

What it means for our positions: the lone BTC LONG is correctly aligned and its stop (83770) sits below EMA300 (84029) — a thesis-correct invalidation, not a noise stop. Two consequences: (a) any SHORT opened while BTC holds EMA300 is counter-trend — 0/4 in 24h, 25% WR over 7d (n=44, -1.26); shorts stay frozen until BTC loses EMA300 or 15m flips SHORT_BIAS. (b) LOW volume + NEGATIVE acceleration means new long entries land in drift, not thrust — this is the exact condition behind the 82-trade/3.7% WR stop-chop cluster over 7d. Prefer trail-confirmed entries (86% WR family) until volume_regime expands. Mean-reversion risk: a snap to EMA300 is -0.65% and would tag our stop — that is the trade working as designed, not a failure.
pattern_alerts:
VERIFIED patterns (PostgreSQL, meta_rsi = _signal_metadata->>'rsi_14', never entry_rsi_14; all queries re-run this cycle):

P1 — SHORTS AGAINST THE TAPE [urgent, regime]. 24h: n=4, 0 wins, -0.33 (BTC x2 ai-trader-pending, COMP -5.7% pump-chain- combo, CRV -2.2% pump-chain-v6-). 7d: n=44, 25% WR, -1.26 vs LONG n=118, 42% WR, -1.66. Post-exit check: both BTC shorts saw price rise +0.66% within 2h of our stop. WINNING SIDE: LONG or no trade — BTC never lost EMA300 during the entire window (1049 min and counting). WHY WE WEREN'T ON IT: the ai-trader-pending conditional path keeps firing shorts while the tape reads LONG_BIAS. Fix: no shorts while BTC holds EMA300 AND 15m is LONG_BIAS.

P2 — STOP-CHOP FAMILIES vs TRAIL FAMILY [urgent, health]. 7d exit families: atr_sl_hit n=50 W=1 net=-3.59; hard_max_loss n=21 W=0 net=-2.38; trail_arm_timeout n=11 W=2 net=-0.48 → combined n=82, 3W (3.7%), -6.45. Trail family: profit-monster-trail n=36 W=32 +1.64, atr_trail_hit n=13 W=10 +1.79 → n=49, 42W (86%), +3.43. WINNING SIDE: the SAME longs, taken only after the +0.40% confirm lets the trail arm — i.e. same direction, later entry. WHY NOT US: pump-chain+/r2v2-long3 fire into LOW-volume drift, coin wiggles ~1% and exits before trail-arm. Entry timing, not direction, is the loss generator.

P3 — DIRECTION RECOVERY AFTER OUR EXITS [warning, health]. 24h: of 20 losing trades, 8 moved >0.5% in our direction within 2h after our exit — GRASS LONG stopped -2.2% then +6.33%, XPL +1.10%, SYRUP +1.03%, CFX +0.79%, COMP LONG +0.66%, INJ LONG +0.66% (x1 of 2), PUMP LONG +2.25%, CRV SHORT -0.97% (whipsaw: stopped long-side, then fell). WINNING SIDE: ours in at least 8/20. Caveat stated honestly: 2h post-exit recovery is a descriptive check, not a strategy backtest — but combined with P2 it says stops are being taken mid-consolidation. Correct exit is later confirmation, not wider stops.

P4 — RSI IS NOT THE LEVER [info, health]. 7d re-verified: losers avg meta_rsi 52.3 (n=85, sd 9.1) vs winners 53.5 (n=51, sd 11.6) — distributions overlap almost completely. Do NOT build 'overbought chase' or 'oversold' steers off any stored RSI column. trend-vs-chop at entry discriminates; RSI does not.

P5 — SAME-COIN CHURN: CLAIM NOT SUPPORTED [info, correction]. Re-entries within 3h of a losing exit, 7d: n=8, 3W, net -0.01 — no edge in either direction. Prior 'churn loses both times' claim is NOT reproducible at this sample size; INJ 0/2 remains real but n=2. Do not ship a re-entry block on this evidence (fails the n>=30 / p<0.05 bar).
